evidence: Bubblewrap 0.9.0 backend and policy/command construction exist, including minimal root view, workspace bind/ro-bind, capability drop, environment clearing and optional network unshare

GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 security runs exposed host-policy limits rather than isolation success: one run failed network namespace loopback setup with RTM_NEWADDR Operation not permitted; another failed user-namespace uid mapping with Permission denied

Runtime namespace isolation is therefore intentionally not marked validated on hosted CI; tests record/skip known unavailable kernel capabilities instead of converting inability-to-start into a false PASS
next: run escape-oriented namespace tests on a self-hosted environment that permits user namespaces
add a Docker/container backend that is testable on hosted CI
validate host-secret invisibility and read-only workspace enforcement
add seccomp or equivalent syscall policy
pids/cpu/memory limits and escape-oriented adversarial tests
